item.title: [7.3] Japanese bond yields fall as lower oil prices ease inflation concerns
item.description:
WHAT HAPPENED

Japanese government bond yields declined due to falling oil prices that eased inflation concerns. The 10-year JGB yield reached a two-week low of 2.715%. Meanwhile, Japan's benchmark Nikkei 225 index experienced a brief surge of 5% following Nvidia's leadership announcement.

WHY IT MATTERS

The convergence of falling JGB yields, a major Nikkei surge driven by tech, and shifting Fed rate expectations provides a useful cross-asset macro update for daily briefings.
